notes:
Crisp asks which way, instead of saying it didn't understand.

Typing 'adjust the brightness' used to get 'I didn't catch an edit in that' — which wasn't true. Crisp knew exactly what you meant and was missing one word: which way.

It now asks, and names the answer: 'Brighter or darker? Crisp got the rest — say brighten it or darken it.' Same for contrast, saturation, exposure, colour, volume, speed and sharpness.
